_meta.about: Nifty 500 companies, batch 006: v2 explainers with profile, five parts, three quiz questions. Leaders checked on the web in Oct 2026 where marked 'Oct 2026'; others marked 'mid-2026, not re-checked'. No figures added.
_meta.review: All entries unreviewed until the founder approves them.

companies.name: CreditAccess Grameen

parts.SELLS: CreditAccess Grameen gives small loans to low-income women in villages and small towns, mostly through joint-liability groups where members back each other. It also offers individual retail loans for small businesses, homes and other needs. It took over Madura Micro Finance and later merged it into itself.
parts.EARNS: It earns the interest gap between what it pays to borrow from banks and markets and what it charges its borrowers. Group microloans remain the core of the book, with Karnataka, Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu among its biggest states.
parts.SIZE: India's largest non-bank microfinance lender by loan book, with a branch network spread across rural and semi-urban India. Its borrowers number in the millions, most of them in Karnataka, Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu.
parts.RIVALS: Bandhan Bank, Spandana Sphoorty, Fusion Finance, Satin Creditcare, Muthoot Microfin and the microfinance arms of banks such as IndusInd and L&T Finance.
parts.WATCH: Whether repayment stress in microfinance keeps easing after lending curbs tightened across the industry, how fast it grows individual retail loans, and how Ganesh Narayanan steers the company after taking over as MD & CEO in August 2025.

quiz.prompt: Who mainly borrows from CreditAccess Grameen?
Which company is a microfinance rival of CreditAccess Grameen?
Who became MD & CEO of CreditAccess Grameen in August 2025?

companies.note_30w: CreditAccess Grameen is India's largest non-bank microfinance lender, giving small group loans to rural women. Watch repayment stress, retail loan growth and its new MD & CEO.

companies.name: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals

parts.SELLS: Crompton makes fans, pumps, water heaters, lighting and small kitchen appliances for homes. It owns a majority of Butterfly Gandhimathi, a South Indian kitchen brand known for mixer grinders and gas stoves. It was demerged from the old Crompton Greaves in 2016 and is run as a separate company.
parts.EARNS: It earns by selling appliances through dealers, retailers and online stores. The electrical consumer durables segment, led by ceiling fans and pumps, brings in most of its revenue, while lighting is a smaller part.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest fan makers and a leading brand in residential pumps, with a dealer network reaching small towns across the country. It also ranks among the top brands in water heaters and residential pumps.
parts.RIVALS: Havells, Orient Electric, Bajaj Electricals, Usha, Polycab and V-Guard in fans and appliances; TTK Prestige and Preethi in kitchen products. Online-first brands such as Atomberg are also winning buyers in premium energy-saving fans.
parts.WATCH: Its push into premium fans and kitchen appliances, how energy-efficiency rules for fans change its product mix, and how it grows Butterfly outside South India under MD & CEO Promeet Ghosh.

quiz.prompt: Which kitchen brand does Crompton own?
Which product line brings Crompton most of its revenue?
options: Fans, pumps and other electrical durables

quiz.prompt: Which company is a direct fan rival of Crompton?

companies.note_30w: Crompton sells fans, pumps, water heaters and kitchen appliances, including the Butterfly brand. It is a top Indian fan maker; watch premium products and Butterfly's expansion.

companies.name: Cupid

parts.SELLS: Cupid makes male and female condoms, water-based lubricants and in-vitro diagnostic test kits. It supplies condoms to governments and global health agencies and also sells its own branded products in India and abroad. New owner Aditya Kumar Halwasiya took charge in 2024 and widened it into consumer products.
parts.EARNS: Much of its income has come from large tenders for condoms placed by health agencies and governments in Africa, Latin America and India. It is growing branded retail sales and diagnostics to depend less on tenders.
parts.SIZE: Among the few Indian makers approved to supply both male and female condoms to global health agencies. Still a small company by FMCG standards. Its main factory is near Nashik in Maharashtra.
parts.RIVALS: Mankind Pharma (Manforce), Reckitt (Durex), TTK Healthcare (Skore), HLL Lifecare and global makers such as Karex in condoms. In diagnostic kits it faces established medical test makers such as J. Mitra and Meril.
parts.WATCH: Its shift from tender-led sales to its own consumer brands, the scale-up of diagnostic kits, new export markets, and capacity expansion announced by management.

quiz.prompt: Which product is Cupid best known for?
Where has much of Cupid's income traditionally come from?
Which brand competes with Cupid in condoms?

companies.note_30w: Cupid makes condoms, lubricants and diagnostic kits, long selling mainly through global health tenders. Under new owners it is building consumer brands and diagnostics.

companies.name: Cyient

parts.SELLS: Cyient sells engineering services: designing aircraft parts, rail systems, medical devices, telecom networks and utility grids for global manufacturers, plus geospatial and digital work. Its electronics manufacturing arm, Cyient DLM, listed separately in 2023 and builds circuit boards and assemblies.
parts.EARNS: It earns fees from long-term engineering contracts with large global clients, billed by time or by project. Aerospace and rail, transport and mobility are among its biggest segments, and North America and Europe bring most of its revenue.
parts.SIZE: One of India's leading engineering and research services companies, smaller than the big IT firms but a known name with aircraft and rail makers worldwide.
parts.RIVALS: Tata Elxsi, L&T Technology Services, KPIT Technologies, Quest Global and the engineering units of HCLTech and Tech Mahindra. Global engineering firms such as Akkodis and Alten also compete for the same clients.
parts.WATCH: How CEO Sukamal Banerjee, who took over in 2025, revives growth, its push into semiconductors and new energy, and leadership changes after a new COO was named in July 2026.

quiz.prompt: What does Cyient mainly sell?
Which Cyient unit listed separately in 2023?
Which company is a rival of Cyient in engineering services?

companies.note_30w: Cyient designs and engineers products for global aircraft, rail, medical and telecom clients. It faces Tata Elxsi and LTTS; watch its growth revival under a new CEO.

companies.name: DOMS Industries

parts.SELLS: DOMS makes pencils, erasers, sharpeners, crayons, colours, pens, notebooks and art kits for school children and offices, sold under the DOMS and Amariz brands. Italy's FILA owns a large stake and helps it export. It listed on the stock exchanges in December 2023.
parts.EARNS: It earns by selling stationery through a large distributor and retailer network in India, plus some exports. Scholastic stationery such as pencils and erasers brings in most revenue, and its own factories in Gujarat keep costs low.
parts.SIZE: India's second-largest branded stationery and art material company, with the leading share in pencils alongside Hindustan Pencils. Its products reach a very wide network of small stationery shops across India.
parts.RIVALS: Hindustan Pencils (Natraj and Apsara), Camlin (Kokuyo Camlin), Faber-Castell, Cello and Classmate from ITC. Global names such as Staedtler and Maped also compete in art and school supplies.
parts.WATCH: Its new large factory in Umbergaon, which management says will start production in FY27, its push into kids' products beyond stationery, and how it handles raw material price swings.

quiz.prompt: Which international company owns a large stake in DOMS?
Which brands compete with DOMS in pencils?
What expansion has DOMS announced?
options: A new large factory in Umbergaon

companies.note_30w: DOMS makes pencils, erasers, crayons and other stationery for students, backed by Italy's FILA. Watch its new Umbergaon factory and push into wider kids' products.

companies.name: Dalmia Bharat

parts.SELLS: Dalmia Bharat makes cement sold under the Dalmia Cement, Konark and Dalmia DSP brands to home builders, contractors and infrastructure projects. It has a strong position in South, East and North-East India and also makes refractories through a related company.
parts.EARNS: It earns by selling cement in bags to retail buyers and in bulk to builders. Blended cement made with fly ash and slag is a large part of its sales, and the East and South regions bring in most of its volumes.
parts.SIZE: One of India's top five cement makers by capacity and a leading player in East and North-East India. It runs plants and grinding units spread across many states.
parts.RIVALS: UltraTech Cement, Ambuja Cements and ACC (Adani), Shree Cement, JK Cement and Ramco Cements. Regional players such as Star Cement and Orient Cement compete hard in its eastern and southern markets.
parts.WATCH: Its announced capacity expansion plan across regions, the cost of fuel and power, cement price trends in its eastern markets, and a new CFO who took charge in August 2026.

quiz.prompt: Which brand belongs to Dalmia Bharat?
Which region is a stronghold for Dalmia Bharat?
Which company is the largest cement rival of Dalmia Bharat?

companies.note_30w: Dalmia Bharat is one of India's top cement makers, strongest in the South and East. It competes with UltraTech and Adani's cement arms; watch its capacity expansion.

companies.name: Data Patterns

parts.SELLS: Data Patterns designs and builds defence and aerospace electronics: radars, electronic warfare systems, avionics, communication equipment and test systems for the armed forces, DRDO and defence PSUs. It also supplies parts for space programmes and has entered counter-drone systems.
parts.EARNS: It earns from development and production orders, mostly from Indian defence agencies and companies such as HAL and BEL. Production orders for complete systems and subsystems bring most revenue, and it designs much of its own technology in-house.
parts.SIZE: One of India's leading private defence electronics makers, small next to BEL but known for doing design work from start to finish. Its order book comes mostly from Indian defence programmes.
parts.RIVALS: Bharat Electronics (BEL), Astra Microwave, Paras Defence, Centum Electronics and Alpha Design Technologies. Large foreign defence firms also bid for the same electronics work, often through Indian partners.
parts.WATCH: Its order inflow from the government's push for local defence equipment, the move to larger complete-system contracts, counter-drone products, export orders, and delays in customer approvals it flagged in 2026.

quiz.prompt: Who are Data Patterns' main customers?
Which company is a defence electronics rival of Data Patterns?
Which new product area has Data Patterns entered?

companies.note_30w: Data Patterns builds radars, avionics and defence electronics for India's armed forces and PSUs. It rivals BEL and Astra Microwave; watch orders and its counter-drone business.

companies.name: Deepak Fertilisers and Petrochemicals (DFPCL)

parts.SELLS: Deepak Fertilisers makes industrial chemicals such as ammonia, nitric acid and isopropyl alcohol, technical ammonium nitrate used in mining explosives, and fertilisers sold under the Mahadhan brand. It runs these through subsidiaries including Mahadhan AgriTech and Deepak Mining Solutions.
parts.EARNS: It earns from selling chemicals to pharma, mining and industrial buyers, and crop nutrients to farmers. Mining chemicals and industrial chemicals bring higher margins than fertilisers, and gas prices drive its costs.
parts.SIZE: India's largest maker of technical ammonium nitrate and one of the main makers of nitric acid and isopropyl alcohol. Its main plants are at Taloja in Maharashtra, with further sites in other states.
parts.RIVALS: Gujarat Narmada Valley Fertilizers (GNFC), Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers, Coromandel International, Chambal Fertilisers and Solar Industries in explosives.
parts.WATCH: Its new ammonia plant at Taloja, the technical ammonium nitrate project at Gopalpur in Odisha, the separate mining solutions business, and how gas price swings affect margins.

quiz.prompt: What is Deepak Fertilisers' fertiliser brand?
Which product is used in mining explosives?
Which company is a rival of Deepak Fertilisers?

companies.note_30w: Deepak Fertilisers makes industrial chemicals, mining-grade ammonium nitrate and Mahadhan fertilisers. It leads in technical ammonium nitrate; watch its new ammonia plant and gas costs.

companies.name: Dr. Lal PathLabs

parts.SELLS: Dr. Lal PathLabs runs diagnostic labs that test blood, urine and tissue samples for patients, doctors and hospitals. It collects samples at its centres, at patient homes and through partner clinics, and owns the Suburban Diagnostics chain in western India.
parts.EARNS: It earns fees for each test, with most money coming from walk-in patients rather than hospitals. Its home market in North India is the largest and most profitable, and bundled wellness test packages are a growing share.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest diagnostic chains, the leader in North India, with a network of labs and collection centres spread across the country. It is especially strong in Delhi and the National Capital Region.
parts.RIVALS: Metropolis Healthcare, Thyrocare (owned by PharmEasy's parent), Tata 1mg Labs, Redcliffe Labs, Apollo Diagnostics and Agilus Diagnostics. Hospital chains also run their own labs and compete for the same patients.
parts.WATCH: Price competition from online labs, its expansion in South and East India, and how CEO Shankha Banerjee, in charge since 2024, grows specialised and genetic tests.

quiz.prompt: Which diagnostic chain does Dr. Lal PathLabs own in western India?
Which region is Dr. Lal PathLabs' strongest market?
Which company is a diagnostic rival of Dr. Lal PathLabs?

companies.note_30w: Dr. Lal PathLabs runs diagnostic labs and collection centres, leading in North India. It competes with Metropolis and online labs; watch pricing pressure and southern expansion.

companies.name: E.I.D. Parry

parts.SELLS: E.I.D. Parry, part of the Murugappa Group, makes sugar, ethanol and other distillery products, and sells consumer goods such as Parry's sugar and pulses. It also owns a majority of Coromandel International, the fertiliser and crop protection company.
parts.EARNS: Through Coromandel, fertilisers and farm chemicals bring in most of its group revenue and profit. Its own business earns from sugar, ethanol sold to oil companies and nutraceuticals, which are more seasonal.
parts.SIZE: One of South India's largest sugar makers and, through Coromandel, part of one of India's biggest private fertiliser groups. Its sugar mills are mainly in Tamil Nadu and Karnataka.
parts.RIVALS: Balrampur Chini, Triveni Engineering and Shree Renuka Sugars in sugar and ethanol; Chambal Fertilisers and UPL against Coromandel. In fertilisers, Coromandel also competes with Paradeep Phosphates and state-run makers.
parts.WATCH: Government ethanol blending policy and sugar export rules, cane availability in Tamil Nadu and Karnataka, and how Coromandel's growth carries the group.

quiz.prompt: Which fertiliser company is majority-owned by E.I.D. Parry?
Where does most of E.I.D. Parry's group revenue come from?
options: Fertilisers and farm chemicals via Coromandel

quiz.prompt: Which company competes with E.I.D. Parry in sugar?

companies.note_30w: E.I.D. Parry makes sugar and ethanol and owns most of Coromandel International, which drives group profits. Watch ethanol policy, cane supply and Coromandel's growth.

companies.name: EIH (The Oberoi Group)

parts.SELLS: EIH is the flagship company of The Oberoi Group. It runs luxury Oberoi hotels and the Trident chain, Nile cruisers, flight catering and airport restaurants. The Oberoi Udaivilas and The Oberoi Amarvilas are among its best-known properties.
parts.EARNS: It earns from room nights, food and drink, and banquets at its hotels, plus management fees from hotels it runs for other owners. Rooms and food at its luxury hotels in big Indian cities and leisure spots bring most profit.
parts.SIZE: One of India's best-known luxury hotel companies, smaller than Indian Hotels but often ranked among the world's top hotel brands. The Oberoi brand has a strong name in luxury travel worldwide.
parts.RIVALS: Indian Hotels (Taj), ITC Hotels, Leela Palaces, Marriott and Hyatt in India. International chains such as Four Seasons and Aman also compete for top-end travellers in India and abroad.
parts.WATCH: New hotels it has announced in India and abroad, strong luxury travel demand, and its catering business as air travel grows. ITC holds a large minority stake.

quiz.prompt: Which hotel chains does EIH run?
Which company is a luxury hotel rival of EIH?
Which company owns a large minority stake in EIH?

companies.note_30w: EIH runs the luxury Oberoi and Trident hotels plus flight catering. It competes with Taj and ITC Hotels; watch new openings and luxury travel demand.

companies.name: Embassy Office Parks REIT

parts.SELLS: Embassy REIT owns large office parks leased to global companies, mostly in Bengaluru, plus Mumbai, Pune and the Delhi region. Tenants include technology firms and global capability centres. It also owns hotels and a solar park. It was India's first listed REIT, in 2019.
parts.EARNS: It earns rent from long-term office leases and passes most of its cash to unit-holders as regular payouts, as REIT rules require. Bengaluru office parks such as Embassy Manyata and Embassy TechVillage bring in most of its rent.
parts.SIZE: India's largest office REIT by area and one of the largest office REITs in Asia. Its tenants are mostly large multinational companies. Its parks include Embassy Manyata and Embassy TechVillage in Bengaluru.
parts.RIVALS: Mindspace Business Parks REIT, Brookfield India REIT and Knowledge Realty Trust, plus office developers such as DLF and RMZ. It competes for tenants with other landlords too, including office arms of developers such as Prestige and Godrej Properties.
parts.WATCH: Leasing demand from global capability centres, new buildings it is constructing within its parks, acquisitions of finished offices, and how CEO Amit Shetty, in charge since August 2025, fills empty space.

quiz.prompt: What does Embassy REIT mainly own?
Which city brings Embassy REIT most of its rent?
Which is a rival office REIT?

companies.note_30w: Embassy REIT owns big office parks, mainly in Bengaluru, leased to global firms. It pays out most rent to unit-holders; watch office leasing and new buildings.

companies.name: Elecon Engineering

parts.SELLS: Elecon makes industrial gearboxes, couplings and material handling equipment such as conveyors and stackers used by steel, cement, power, sugar and mining plants. It owns UK gear maker Benzlers-Radicon and sells across Europe, the Americas and Asia.
parts.EARNS: Gear and transmission products bring in most of its revenue and profit, with steady demand for spares and replacements. The material handling business is smaller and project-based, and overseas sales are a growing share.
parts.SIZE: One of Asia's largest industrial gear makers and India's leading maker of gearboxes for heavy industry. It sells gears to steel, cement, power and many other heavy industries in India and abroad.
parts.RIVALS: Siemens (Flender), SEW-Eurodrive, Premium Transmission, Shanthi Gears and Bonfiglioli. In material handling it competes with Tata's TRF, Thyssenkrupp and FLSmidth.
parts.WATCH: Its push to grow overseas sales of gears, new capacity it has announced, demand from steel, cement and defence, and its 75th anniversary year in 2026 under Prayasvin Patel, reappointed CMD from July 2026.

quiz.prompt: What is Elecon's main product?
Which UK gear maker does Elecon own?
Which company competes with Elecon in gears?

companies.note_30w: Elecon makes industrial gearboxes and material handling equipment for steel, cement and power plants. It is a leading Asian gear maker; watch overseas growth and capacity.

companies.name: ELGi Equipments

parts.SELLS: ELGi makes air compressors, from small piston units for garages to large screw and oil-free compressors for factories, hospitals and mines. It also makes automotive service equipment. It sells in India, the US, Europe and Australia through subsidiaries and distributors.
parts.EARNS: It earns from selling compressors plus a steady stream of spares and servicing. Screw compressors bring in most revenue, and overseas markets, led by the US and Europe, now make up a large part of sales.
parts.SIZE: India's largest air compressor maker and one of the top compressor brands worldwide. Its products are sold in many countries through subsidiaries and distributors.
parts.RIVALS: Atlas Copco, Ingersoll Rand, Kaeser and Kirloskar Pneumatic. Kirloskar Pneumatic is its closest Indian rival, while the others are global brands with factories in India. Chinese makers are a growing threat on price.
parts.WATCH: Growth in the US and Europe, its oil-free compressor range, Chinese competition it has flagged as a concern, and how input costs affect margins. New products for the US market are a stated focus.

quiz.prompt: What does ELGi mainly make?
Which company is a global rival of ELGi?
Which competition has ELGi flagged as a concern?

companies.note_30w: ELGi is India's largest air compressor maker, selling across India, the US and Europe. It competes with Atlas Copco and Ingersoll Rand; watch overseas growth.

companies.name: Emcure Pharmaceuticals

parts.SELLS: Emcure makes branded medicines for women's health, heart, blood and infection treatments, plus injectables and biosimilars. It sells in India and in many emerging and European markets, and markets some Sanofi heart medicines in India. It listed on the stock exchanges in July 2024.
parts.EARNS: It earns by selling branded prescription drugs to doctors and hospitals in India, its largest market, and through subsidiaries in Europe and Canada. Gynaecology and cardiology brands are among its biggest earners in India.
parts.SIZE: A mid-sized Indian pharma company and one of the leaders in gynaecology medicines in India. It sells its medicines in many countries beyond India. It is listed in India.
parts.RIVALS: Mankind Pharma, Sun Pharma, Alkem, Intas and Abbott India in branded generics. In biosimilars it faces Biocon Biologics, Intas and Dr. Reddy's. Global drugmakers also compete with it abroad.
parts.WATCH: Its biosimilars pipeline, growth in Europe and Canada, and leadership as founder Satish Mehta became chairman from September 2026 while staying MD. Founder Satish Mehta also has a further term as MD from April 2027 awaiting shareholder approval.

quiz.prompt: Which therapy area is Emcure a leader in within India?
When did Emcure list on the stock exchanges?
Which role did Satish Mehta add in September 2026?

companies.note_30w: Emcure sells branded medicines for women's health, heart and blood disorders in India and abroad. Watch biosimilars, Europe and founder Satish Mehta's added chairman role.

companies.name: Emmvee Photovoltaic Power

parts.SELLS: Emmvee makes solar panels (modules) and the solar cells that go inside them, selling to solar power developers, rooftop installers and distributors in India. It listed on the stock exchanges in November 2025.
parts.EARNS: It earns by selling modules and cells, with modules bringing in most revenue. Making its own cells earns better margins because government rules increasingly require locally made cells for many projects.
parts.SIZE: One of India's larger solar module makers and among the few that also make their own solar cells at scale. Its plants are in Karnataka, near Bengaluru.
parts.RIVALS: Waaree Energies, Premier Energies, Adani Solar, Vikram Solar, Tata Power Solar and ReNew. Chinese module makers remain the main price-setters in the global solar market.
parts.WATCH: Its integrated TOPCon cell and module plant, with modules due by December 2026 and cells by March 2027, the ALMM List II rule for local cells, and pricing pressure as capacity grows.

quiz.prompt: What does Emmvee make?
Which company competes with Emmvee?
Which government rule supports demand for Emmvee's cells?

companies.note_30w: Emmvee makes solar cells and modules for Indian developers and installers. It competes with Waaree and Premier; watch its new TOPCon plant and local-cell rules.

companies.name: Endurance Technologies

parts.SELLS: Endurance makes parts for two-wheelers, three-wheelers and cars: aluminium die castings, suspension, brakes, clutches and transmission parts. Bajaj Auto is its biggest customer. It also makes castings for carmakers in Europe through its subsidiaries there.
parts.EARNS: It earns by supplying parts to vehicle makers under long-term arrangements, plus aftermarket sales. India brings most revenue, led by two-wheeler parts, while Europe adds castings for car brands.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest two-wheeler component makers and a leading maker of motorcycle suspension and brakes. It has plants across India and in Europe.
parts.RIVALS: Gabriel India, Sundram Fasteners, Uno Minda, Brembo and Bosch. Global suppliers such as ZF and KYB also compete for two-wheeler suspension work. Brembo is a strong rival in premium brakes.
parts.WATCH: Growth in electric two-wheeler parts such as battery packs, new customers beyond Bajaj Auto, its European business, and raw material shortages it flagged in 2026.

quiz.prompt: Who is Endurance's largest customer?
Which product does Endurance make?
Which company is a rival of Endurance?

companies.note_30w: Endurance makes castings, suspension and brakes for two-wheelers, with Bajaj Auto its top client. Watch EV parts, new customers and its European castings business.

companies.name: Engineers India (EIL)

parts.SELLS: Engineers India is a government-owned engineering consultancy. It designs and manages construction of oil refineries, petrochemical plants, pipelines, fertiliser plants and other industrial projects for clients such as Indian Oil, BPCL and HPCL, and for overseas clients.
parts.EARNS: It earns consultancy fees for design and project management, which give higher margins, plus turnkey contracts where it builds whole projects. Consultancy for refineries and petrochemicals is its most profitable work.
parts.SIZE: India's largest engineering consultancy for oil, gas and petrochemical projects. It is majority owned by the Government of India. It has worked on most of India's big refineries.
parts.RIVALS: Tata Projects, Larsen & Toubro's energy business, Toyo Engineering, Technip Energies and McDermott. For overseas projects it also faces Korean and Italian engineering firms such as Samsung E&A and Saipem.
parts.WATCH: Refinery expansions announced by state oil companies, overseas orders in the Middle East and Africa, and a new CMD, Atul Gupta, who took charge in 2026.

quiz.prompt: Which kind of projects does EIL mainly design?
Which EIL work gives the highest margins?
Who became EIL's Chairman & MD in 2026?

companies.note_30w: Engineers India is a state-owned consultancy that designs refineries, pipelines and petrochemical plants. Watch refinery orders, overseas work and its new CMD.

companies.name: Fertilisers and Chemicals Travancore (FACT)

parts.SELLS: FACT is a government-owned fertiliser maker in Kerala. It sells complex fertilisers such as Factamfos and ammonium sulphate to farmers, mostly in South India, plus chemicals like caprolactam. Founded in 1943, it was India's first large-scale fertiliser plant.
parts.EARNS: It earns by selling fertilisers at government-set prices and receiving subsidy from the government for the gap. Complex fertilisers bring in most revenue, and southern states are its main market.
parts.SIZE: One of India's major government-owned fertiliser makers and a key supplier of complex fertilisers in South India. Its main plants are at Udyogamandal and Ambalamedu near Kochi.
parts.RIVALS: Coromandel International, Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers, Madras Fertilizers, Zuari Agro and Chambal Fertilisers. Imported fertilisers also compete with its products in southern markets.
parts.WATCH: Its start of DAP production in 2026, government subsidy rates, raw material import costs, and changes in its board after several directors moved on in 2026.

quiz.prompt: What is FACT's well-known complex fertiliser brand?
How does FACT earn on fertilisers?
Which company is a rival of FACT?

companies.note_30w: FACT is a government fertiliser maker in Kerala selling complex fertilisers like Factamfos, backed by subsidies. Watch its new DAP output and subsidy rates.

companies.name: Finolex Cables

parts.SELLS: Finolex Cables makes electrical wires and cables for homes and industry, communication cables and optical fibre, plus fans, switches, lights and water heaters. Most products are sold through dealers to electricians and builders.
parts.EARNS: Electrical wires for homes and buildings bring in most of its revenue and profit. Communication cables are smaller, and newer consumer electrical products add volume.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest makers of electrical wires and cables, especially strong in house wires in western India. Its brand is widely trusted by electricians across India.
parts.RIVALS: Polycab, Havells, KEI Industries, RR Kabel and V-Guard. In fans and switches it also competes with Crompton, Anchor (Panasonic) and Legrand. Large groups such as UltraTech have also entered cables.
parts.WATCH: Its new CEO Mahesh Viswanathan, appointed in June 2026, optical fibre capacity it has built, a long-running promoter family dispute, and copper price swings.

quiz.prompt: Which product brings Finolex Cables most of its revenue?
Which company is a cable rival of Finolex Cables?
Who became Finolex Cables' CEO in June 2026?

companies.note_30w: Finolex Cables makes electrical wires, communication cables and electricals, strong in house wires. It rivals Polycab and Havells; watch its new CEO and copper costs.

companies.name: Firstsource Solutions

parts.SELLS: Firstsource, part of the RP-Sanjiv Goenka Group, runs business processes for other companies: customer service, collections, mortgage processing, healthcare billing and claims, and digital operations. Its clients are banks, health insurers, hospitals, telecom and media companies, mostly in the US and UK.
parts.EARNS: It earns fees under multi-year outsourcing contracts, priced per transaction, per hour or by outcome. The US is its largest market, followed by the UK, and banking and healthcare clients bring in most revenue.
parts.SIZE: One of India's larger business process management companies, mid-sized next to global players like Teleperformance. It works for many large US and UK banks, health insurers and media companies.
parts.RIVALS: Teleperformance, Concentrix, WNS (now part of Capgemini), eClerx, Hinduja Global Solutions and the BPM arms of Infosys and TCS. AI tools that automate customer service are also a new kind of competition.
parts.WATCH: How it uses AI tools to automate work it does for clients, new deals in healthcare and banking, acquisitions in the US and UK, and the impact of automation on traditional call-centre work.

quiz.prompt: Which group is Firstsource part of?
Which is Firstsource's largest market?
Which company is a rival of Firstsource?

companies.note_30w: Firstsource runs customer service, collections and healthcare processes for US and UK clients. It competes with Teleperformance and Concentrix; watch how AI changes outsourcing work.

companies.name: Five-Star Business Finance

parts.SELLS: Five-Star gives small business loans to self-employed people such as shopkeepers and small traders who lack formal income papers. Loans are secured against the borrower's house. It listed on the stock exchanges in 2022.
parts.EARNS: It earns high interest on small, property-backed loans, funded by bank borrowings and equity. Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh and Telangana bring in most of its loans, and its own field staff assess cash flows door to door.
parts.SIZE: One of India's leading lenders for small, property-backed business loans, strongest in South India. It has a large branch network in small towns and villages.
parts.RIVALS: SBFC Finance, Aptus Value Housing, Veritas Finance, Shriram Finance and small finance banks such as AU and Equitas. Informal moneylenders are also a big rival, since many of its borrowers had little access to formal credit.

companies.name: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers (GRSE)

companies.name: General Insurance Corporation of India (GIC Re)

parts.EARNS: It earns from supplying batteries and electronics to Indian Railways, defence forces and aircraft makers. Kavach orders from the railways have become its fastest-growing and most watched business.
parts.SIZE: One of a small group of companies approved to supply Kavach to Indian Railways, and a leading maker of specialised industrial batteries in India. Its batteries are used in aircraft and by the armed forces.

companies.name: HDB Financial Services

parts.SELLS: HDB Financial Services is the non-bank lending arm of HDFC Bank. It gives business loans and loans against property, finances commercial vehicles, construction equipment and tractors, and offers personal and consumer durable loans. It listed on the stock exchanges in July 2025.
parts.EARNS: It earns the interest gap between its borrowing costs and loan rates, plus fees. Enterprise lending to small businesses and asset finance are its largest books, and it also earns fees for back-office services to HDFC Bank.
parts.SIZE: One of India's larger non-bank lenders, with branches spread across small towns and cities. Its parent HDFC Bank owns most of the company. It serves many customers in small towns.
parts.RIVALS: Bajaj Finance, Shriram Finance, Cholamandalam Finance, Tata Capital and L&T Finance. Banks, including HDFC Bank itself in some products, also compete for the same borrowers.
parts.WATCH: Loan quality in its unsecured and vehicle loans, RBI rules on overlap between banks and their lending arms, and its new chairman from May 2026. Growth after its listing is also watched.

companies.name: HEG Advanced Materials

It keeps advanced materials such as synthetic graphite anodes for lithium-ion batteries and graphene, battery energy solutions and green power.
parts.EARNS: Its power plants earn from selling electricity. The anode business, run through The Advanced Carbons Company, is at an early stage, so the company's future earnings depend on battery materials scaling up.
